test.result: 15 passed; Ruff and mypy passed for the new module.

implemented: A strict return bridge requires realized and unrealized price P&L, carry, cash yield, financing, tax, slippage and trading fees, including explicit zero values.
Every component requires a source hash, uses one reporting currency, and is reconciled against NAV change net of external flows under a declared rounding tolerance.
Missing components, unprovenanced inputs, currency mismatches, negative cost values and unexplained residuals fail closed.
blockers: The bridge is not yet derived automatically from durable PaperAccount fills, positions, marks and corporate-action events.
Execution slippage and carry sources need to be joined to the same canonical paper-account attribution feed.
